decision_rules.not_shown_rate_reliant: F 95% CI upper bound < 0.25 (test-time duration change explains less than a quarter of the group logit gap)
decision_rules.note: F linearly extrapolates the locked model response from +-25% stretches to the observed group duration difference
decision_rules.otherwise: inconclusive; report estimates and intervals only
decision_rules.rate_reliant: F 95% CI lower bound >= 0.25 AND both diagnosis slopes > 0 with CIs excluding 0 AND median roundtrip |delta logit| < 0.5 x median |delta logit| at rate_0.80/rate_1.25

models: locked V10-Reference speech_only outer-fold heads (seed x outer) and frozen fold thresholds; no retraining
pipeline_checks: re-extraction of 2 unmodified recordings per speaker reproduces frozen embeddings (relative max diff < 1e-3)
locked-fold scoring of all recordings reproduces published OOF probabilities (max abs diff < 1e-6)
preprocessing: frozen V8 preprocess_waveform, then time_stretch, then V8 peak-normalise, array gate and centre 12 s crop
primary_estimand: duration-explained fraction F = S x dD / G, where S = speaker-weighted mean within-speaker slope of seed-mean logit on log2(duration factor) over the five DOSE conditions (both diagnoses pooled); dD = dysarthric minus control mean of speaker-mean log2(source_seconds) in the subset; G = dysarthric minus control mean seed-mean identity logit
secondary_estimands: rate-swap delta AUC = AUC(controls rate_0.80, dysarthric rate_1.25) - AUC(identity), five-seed mean
reverse swap delta AUC = AUC(controls rate_1.25, dysarthric rate_0.80) - AUC(identity)
subset: 50 recordings per TORGO speaker, chosen by SHA-256 of source_id (label-blind); same subset in every condition
uncertainty: physical-speaker bootstrap within diagnosis, one draw shared across seeds, 10000 resamples, seed 20261018; draws with G <= 0 give F = NaN and are counted
